title: malaxis palustris
intro: Malaxis palustris, commonly known as Marsh Orchid, is a type of terrestrial orchid that belongs to the family Orchidaceae. This plant has been traditionally used in folk medicine, and its health benefits include anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties, which can help in treating various health conditions. The therapeutic actions of Malaxis palustris include antioxidant, antiviral, and antifungal properties, which contribute to its potential in treating infections and oxidative stress-related disorders. The bioactive constituents of Malaxis palustris include flavonoids, alkaloids, and phenolic acids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
